{{Top|leg}}
'''Holotheaters''', also known as '''holotheatres''',<ref name="CP">''[[Star Wars Campaign Pack]]''</ref> or '''holographic theaters''', were exhibition spaces where programming, such as entertainment shows, documentaries, sporting events, and news were shown. Most theaters had a central [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] [[Holoprojector/Legends|projection unit]] that was capable of displaying images at a height of thirty [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall. [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], such as [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]], had public holotheaters,<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> as did [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]] which was the location of the [[Imperial Cavalcade of Stars]].<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>

Around [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] came into possession of a [[Brosso Mark II]] [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]]. He used it to set up a makeshift holotheater in the [[Kamar Badlands]], where he showed the only film he had access to, a [[holodocumentary]] called ''[[Varn, World of Water]].'' Due to communication difficulties, he failed to realize that the [[desert]] dwelling [[Kamarian]] [[Kamarian Badlander|Badlanders]] revered water and had set up a [[Cult of Varn|religion]] around the film. When Han tried to show another film, ''[[Love is Waiting]],'' the cultists rioted, forcing Solo and his companions to flee in the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Millennium Falcon]].<ref name="HSR">''[[Han Solo's Revenge]]''</ref>

Holotheaters could be small, and were sometimes included as a feature aboard luxury star [[Yacht/Legends|yachts]] such as the [[GX1 short hauler/Legends|GX1 Short Hauler]]. When [[Reekeene's Roughnecks]] modified the GX1 Short Hauler ''[[Long Shot]]'', they removed the holotheater as it was not needed for their purposes.<ref name="SWCP">''[[Star Wars Campaign Pack]]''</ref> The [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Ithorian Herdship|Herdship]] ''[[Bazaar (Ithorian Herdship)|Bazaar]]'' had three holotheaters located in [[Isttu Village]].<ref name="Graveyard">''[[Graveyard of Alderaan]]''</ref>
